{{Quote|I am the Overseer. The Builders programmed me to enforce discipline among the slaves while this monument to the power of the Star Forge was constructed.|Overseer|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Overseer''' was the name given to a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Rakatan guardian droid|guardian droid]] created during the height of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] around [[30,000 BBY]].

==Biography==
The droid supervised the construction of a temple on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], ensuring its completion according to specifications and enforcing discipline among the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] assigned to the project. As such, it was programmed to communicate in the ancient [[Rakata (language)|Rakata language]], as well as the languages of the Infinite Empire's slave species, including ancient [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] and [[Tusken/Legends|Tusken]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

At the conclusion of the project and the execution of all slaves involved, the Overseer was reprogrammed by the Rakata, remaining at the site to provide information about the [[Star Forge]] to any of their species who sought it. This function would go unused, as no Rakata ever returned to the temple to access the [[Star Map]] within.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Millennia later, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] would encounter the Overseer in the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] when they entered the temple, now reduced to [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|ruins]], seeking knowledge of the Star Forge to fuel their desire for conquest. The droid informed them that to enter the temple's penetralia, they would have to prove themselves "worthy" by showing their understanding of the reasoning of the ancient Rakata. The pair succeeded in this trial, beginning their journey across the galaxy to other Star Maps and initiating their transformation into Darth Revan and Darth Malak.<ref name="KOTOR" />

In [[3956 BBY]], the amnesiac Revan returned to the Rakatan ruins with [[Bastila Shan]] and encountered the Overseer once more. The droid, which gave no indication that it recognized the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], again informed the temple's visitors of the objective to which they were assigned. They also completed the task successfully, discovering the means by which Revan and Malak had learned of the Star Forge's location.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', the Overseer says that the Rakata left it on Dantooine more than 20,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier, which [[Bastila Shan|Bastila]] says would make it "nearly 5,000 years older than the Republic itself." However, since the Republic was founded [[25,053 BBY|circa 25,000 BBY]] and ''Knights of the Old Republic'' takes place [[3956 BBY|circa 4,000 BBY]], this is apparently an error. This article assumes that the claim that the droid was 5,000 years older than the Republic is correct, placing it on Dantooine [[30,000 BBY|circa 30,000 BBY]].

The droid also remarks that Revan and Bastila are "not of the slave species," implying that [[Human/Legends|Human]]s were not enslaved by the Infinite Empire, but this would later be contradicted by ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]''.
